data.name: Sadaan
data.gender_notes: Sadaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who supports, helps, provides, aids, assists, protects, defends, gives refuge. The name Sadaan carries the meaning “One who protects, helps” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Sadaan usually hope their child will grow to embody one who protects, helps and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Protector, helper, supporter, provider, aider, defender
data.etymology: Sadaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who protects, helps.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadaan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: سعدان
in_arabic.meaning: سعدان تعني الفرح والسرور والخير الكثير
in_arabic.long_meaning: سعدان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الفرح والسرور والخير الكثير، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية ٤٥ 'وَأَرسَلنَاْ الريحَ مُثيرةً سَحاباً فَسُقينَاهُ ماءً كَثيراً' حيث يدل على الخير والنماء. ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية لما يحمله من معاني إيجابية وطيبة.

in_urdu.name: سعدان
in_urdu.meaning: سعدان کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور بہت سارا خیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: سعدان ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور بہت سارا خیر۔ اس نام کی اصولی جڑیں عربی زبان میں ہیں جہاں یہ 'سعد' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوش ہونا یا خوش کرنا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کا استعمال شائع ہے کیونکہ یہ نام خوبی اور خوشحالی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सदन
in_hindi.meaning: सदन का अर्थ है खुशी और बहुत सारा सुख
in_hindi.long_meaning: सदन एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है खुशी और बहुत सारा सुख। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जहां यह 'साद' से व्युत्पन्न हुआ है जिसका अर्थ है खुश होना या खुश करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में इस नाम का उपयोग आम है क्योंकि यह नाम अच्छाई और समृद्धि का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: سعدان
in_pashto.meaning: سعدان معنی یې خوښۍ او ډیر خیر
in_pashto.long_meaning: سعدان د عربي اصل مذکر نوم دی چې معنی یې خوښۍ او ډیر خیر دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چیرته چې دا 'سعد' څخه مشتق شوی دی چې معنی یې خوش وي یا خوش کړي. په اسلامي کلتور کې ددې نوم استعمال عام دی ځکه چې دا نوم د نیکۍ او سوکالۍ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Sadaan
in_english.meaning: Sadaan means happiness and much goodness
in_english.long_meaning: Sadaan is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning happiness and much goodness. It is derived from the Arabic root 'sa'd', which means to be happy or to make happy. The name has a rich history in Islamic tradition and is often chosen for its positive connotations and implications of prosperity and joy. The Quranic reference to concepts of happiness and goodness further supports the significance of this name in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sadaan in Arabic culture has a strong connotation of generosity, kindness, and support towards others. It is often associated with providing comfort, assistance, or reaching out a helping hand to those in need. In many Muslim communities, those bearing the name Sadaan are considered ustadhs (teachers or mentors) who offer guidance, protection, and advice to their mentes. Moreover, Sadaans are often considered community leaders or pillars who are always present to support and uplift those around them. In various social contexts, a Sadaan may be known for their charitable deeds, initiatives, or organizations, thereby reflecting the spirit of altruism and care for others inherent in the name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sadaan holds immense significance in the Islamic faith. It is a reminder of the fundamental tenet of faith - the belief in Allah (God) as the Provider, Sustainer, and Supreme Protector. The name Sadaan reinforces the importance of engaging in acts of sadaqa (charity) and ibadah (worship), and offering support and protection to others as acts of worship pleasing to Allah. It is a call to uphold the values of compassion, generosity, and selflessness, and strive to become a source of aid and refuge for others. Ultimately, the name Sadaan serves as a daily inspiration to live a life governed by the excellence of character and compassionate actions of Rasulullah (Prophet Muhammad), offering support and Solace to those who seek refuge in Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "One who protects, helps" symbolizes One who supports, helps, provides, aids, assists, protects, defends, gives refuge. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Sadaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of one who protects, helps.
